chunks: ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain ibn Mūsā ibn Bābawayh narrated to me from ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Muḥammad ibn Sadaqah, from Sāliḥ Al-Nīli, who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said: Those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) knowing his rights are like those who have performed Hajj three times accompanying the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.).
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husain (a.s.)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* emphasizes that *ziyarah* to Imam al-Husain (a.s.) is not merely a physical visit but a spiritual act contingent upon *ma'rifah* (gnostic knowledge) of his station and rights. By equating this visitation with three *Hajjats* performed alongside the Prophet, the Imam underscores the immense reward of the Ahl al-Bayt's martyrdom and its role as a means of intercession and spiritual purification in Shia tradition.

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said: Those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) knowing his rights are like those who have performed Hajj three times accompanying the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.).
